boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase study, recreation, and library activities available to UC Merced students or the Merced community.

cards.title: Settle into the 24/7 study area
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library, UC Merced
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a low-key work session in KL 155, then use the first-come seating to reset between assignments.
cards.short_summary: A designated 24-hour campus study area for eligible UC Merced students, staff, and faculty.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library identifies KL 155 as a 24-hour study area with first-come access for students, staff, and faculty.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Eligible users: UC Merced students, staff, and faculty; holiday and finals closures may apply.

cards.title: Read quietly in the McFadden-Willis Room
cards.subtitle: KL 455, Kolligian Library, UC Merced
cards.notes: Plan a quiet reading hour here with a classmate, keeping conversation for before or after the designated quiet-study time.
cards.short_summary: A named fourth-floor quiet-study room in the Kolligian Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library designates the McFadden-Willis Reading Room, KL 455, as a quiet study area for students, staff, and faculty.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Eligible users: UC Merced students, staff, and faculty.

cards.title: Work through a group assignment together
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library, UC Merced
cards.notes: Reserve a Collaborative Work Room for an academic project, bring a clear agenda, and use the shared time to finish one task.
cards.short_summary: Reservable campus rooms intended for academic group work and collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library states that Collaborative Work Rooms may be reserved for academic activities, group assignments, and collaborative study by undergraduate and graduate students.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Available to undergraduate and graduate students; use is for academic activities.

cards.title: Join an intramural team
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation, UC Merced
cards.notes: Use the free-agent option to meet teammates, bring your CatCard, and choose a league that matches your schedule and comfort level.
cards.short_summary: Registered students can participate in UC Merced intramural sports with their CatCard.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Recreation says all currently registered students are eligible for intramural sports and can use IMLeagues to connect with free agents and team captains.
cards.source_title: Who Can Play | UC Merced Recreation & Athletics
cards.access_notes: For currently registered UC Merced students; bring a CatCard to games.

cards.title: Connect at campus with a visitor
cards.subtitle: UC Merced campus
cards.notes: Meet up on campus with a visitor and use the guest network for planning, research, or a shared online task without buying access.
cards.short_summary: Campus internet access is available to visitors through UC Merced’s guest network.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced states that visitors without a UCM Net ID can access its guest network while on campus.
cards.source_title: Campus Wide Internet Access | UC Merced Office of Information Technology
cards.access_notes: For visitors or people without a UCM Net ID during their time on campus.

cards.title: Do a web-research hour at the library
cards.subtitle: Merced Main Library, 2100 O Street
cards.notes: Head to the Main Library with a friend, reserve a public computer in person, and keep printing optional since it has a per-page fee.
cards.short_summary: Free public internet access with in-person, first-come computer reservations.
cards.evidence_claim: Merced County Library provides free public internet access; public-computer access is available in person on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.access_notes: Internet sessions are limited to 60 minutes daily, subject to availability; printing costs extra.

cards.title: Pair up for free literacy tutoring
cards.subtitle: Merced Main Library, first floor
cards.notes: Contact Read and Succeed to get matched with a tutor, set one practical goal, and use the session to build reading or computer skills.
cards.short_summary: A free, learner-centered literacy tutoring program at the Merced Main Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Merced County’s Read and Succeed program offers individual tutoring, books, and materials free of charge at the Merced Main Library.
cards.source_title: Read and Succeed | Merced County Library
cards.access_notes: Eligibility is determined through a brief assessment and application; contact the program to begin.

cards.title: Order a book for pickup with a friend
cards.subtitle: Merced County Library system
cards.notes: Compare reading picks, place holds through the library system, and choose a pickup library for a no-cost shared reading project.
cards.short_summary: Library-card holders can receive free transit and delivery for items ordered from member SJVLS libraries.
cards.evidence_claim: Merced County Library lists free transit and delivery of items ordered from member San Joaquin Valley Library System libraries as a library-card privilege.
cards.access_notes: Requires a Merced County Library card; interlibrary loans outside the SJVLS may carry a fee.

cards.title: Host a library-card movie night
cards.subtitle: Merced County Library digital service
cards.notes: Pick a title together, sign in with a library card and PIN, and make the hang about discussing the film instead of buying tickets.
cards.short_summary: A library-card streaming service with free access to thousands of movies.
cards.evidence_claim: Merced County Library says Kanopy provides free access to thousands of movies when users enter a library-card number and PIN.
cards.source_title: Apps at Your Library | Merced County Library
cards.access_notes: Requires a Merced County Library card number and PIN; use a personal device.

cards.title: Try a language lesson together
cards.subtitle: Merced County Library digital service
cards.notes: Choose a language and work through a short Pronunciator lesson side by side, then practice a few phrases on the walk home.
cards.short_summary: Free online language and ESL courses available with a Merced County Library card.
cards.evidence_claim: Merced County Library states that Pronunciator is free with a library card and offers language learning and ESL courses on computers and mobile devices.
cards.access_notes: Requires a Merced County Library card and works on computer or mobile devices.
